place.name: Alligator Pond
place.description: Alligator Pond is a fishing village on the southwestern coast of Jamaica in the parish of Manchester. Unlike the tourist-oriented coasts in the northern part of the country, Alligator Pond's shoreline is balanced between work and recreational activities; here, fishermen launch their boats to catch fish, often regarded as the freshest on the island while women conduct the wholesale business of the catch.
